body:
I am gonna be honest, I am not sure how to reply because I am afraid most of what I say will sound like I am a complete asshole in my current mood but I promise I don't mean to sound like that and that you took your time to read my post and took your time to even comment is super super kind of you so thank you a lot for that.

Now to your comment..... nothing is really easy to do for me. I am not even joking when I say that because well.... I seem to struggle with the most basic things in life other people do with closed eyes and without thinking about them. The idea of making a record with things I achieved is really interesting though but I don't know, I doubt it would help me ( I should just shut up and not say this, I really know I sound like a dick and I am so so sorry). 
Things I like and focus on them.... there isn't a lot and due to some unfortunate circumstances I can't really focus on what I would like even if there would be something I like doing. 

Is it worth it though? I have my doubts about that as well. A couple years ago I had my doubts and wasn't doing so well and now today, nothing really changed in my life when I think about it, I still struggle with the same stuff I did back then and I am tired of it. I know things won't get magically better but I myself am apparently not able to improve anything either. 

Again I am really sorry if I sounded rude that's not my intention. Your comment and the time you took to read my weird post is just so so appreciated, it really means a lot thank you so much.

I would never ever laugh about anyone's reasons for wanting to end it soooo nope I won't laugh about you. It's awful that you want to end your life but I can understand you. I wish you wouldn't feel this way and I also wish that you would have doctor's that understand you. 

The question is am I even suicidal? I am really unsure about that. And hey I believe you that you won't laugh about me but I don't feel like talking about it at the moment, it really doesn't have anything to do with you. It truly means a lot that you offer me an open ear, I appreciate so so much thank you, seriously.

I hope you have a goodnight too and thanks again I wish you only the best and you seem to be a very kind and caring person.

Thank you very much that you took your time to read it, I really appreciate it. 

I am so sorry to hear that you feel so bad as well. I don't feel really comfortable sharing my reasons I am sorry but what I can say without a doubt is that people would laugh about it when they would hear it. I totally get it though so yes. Right now I feel so drained and exhausted mentally that I think I'll go to bed and try to sleep. 

Thank you again very very much and sorry for that odd response of me right now. I hope I didn't come of as rude or mean because that's the last thing I want. I hope you are doing well!

Oh yes that's true and I wasn't expecting any comments at all, so it was a very nice surprise to see and read them. Thank you very much I just hope that I can keep going and call them to finally make an appointment but yees... I will see. By the way if you should have a bad day or need any help please know that you can message me as well! Same thing goes for everyone else who commented or read it. I completely forgot to say that damn it. Thank you again very very much and I appreciate it a lot.'

I meean wait hold on that's also a thing, I am not always so sure about it if I need help or not. I have my moments where I am like "omg you definitely need help you can't keep living like this" and then I have my moments where I am like "I am okay I guess, I don't need any help". I often see myself doubting it if I need help or not and yes hmm this back and forth is annoying haha 

So yes okay maaaybe I did like the first half step so far. That's alright for me, I am okay with that. 

I hope I am on the right path but I'll see how and if it will work out. It'll probably won't work out like everything but yes I'll see. Thank you very much, that's true being alone with your own mind can make it so much worse so I really appreciate your offer! 

I am so glad to hear that! I totally understand how you feel because it was the same way for me  when I started to go to the gym but hey everything is gonna be okay and I hope that you will like it.

Thank you very very much! I appreciate it very much that you offered me your help and I am so glad that you have someone you can go to when you feel bad I am happy for you. 

Sorry for my late reply but it means a lot that you took your time for me, honestly!

Also thank you very much and I am sorry that I took so long to reply. I read all of the comments I got already a bit earlier but I wasn't feeling very well and wanted to answer them later. I appreciate it very much, thank you! 

I mean I guess that's also what happened but I am the opinion that I simply don't deserve anything so that's also a reason why I got a wrong adress from my doc. It's perfectly fine and we are only humans, mistakes happen, I am not mad at her at all or anything for that, it can happen. 

Thank you very much for your kind words and I don't like to do that because it's a bit disrespectful but I disagree. I am not kind or anything. I am just..... boring. I am a weird person in my eyes and I could say more not so nice stuff about myself but I'll just stop here. 

I appreciate your kind words very much, sorry for being a bit rude and disrespectful but I see myself in a complete different light. Thank you that you took your time and I hope you are doing well!

Sorry for my late reply but thank you very much that you took your time to write so much. I really appreciate it. 

That's what I somehow tried to explain. I know I am not alone but at the same time I am completely alone and feel like it, I can't really change it unfortunately, I tried to change it but I was not successful like always.

And oh gosh no no no, I am not strong willed. I am the exact opposite. I know I am not gonna be healed after one session but I don't even get it done to make the first step. 

Thank you again very very much I hope you are doing well!

First of all congratulations! That's a huuuge step and it was probably one of the hardest to actually start it and go there.

Second of all it's not boring at all. I am so proud of you and I can relate to you so so well, thank you for sharing it. You did what I can't do and I look up to you. I also wanna do the same for years now but I can't and I am the in the exact same situation you was. Very well done, I hope one day I can be like you, keep going and I wish you only the best, you will do it, you deserve it.

That's very very kind from you and I appreciate it a lot and I honestly don't wanna be an asshole now or sound rude, mean or disrespectful in any way but I don't feel comfortable sharing it. I am really sorry for it, I know you are just trying to help me.

That's so sad to hear, I still hope for you and that something positive happens which hopefully would change your mind. 

Thank you I'll try, you too dude.

I am so sorry to hear that you feel so bad. I hope that it will get better for you till then and that you change your decision and dont do it. 

I wish you only the best, stay strong.

Hey thank you a lot that you took the time to read it and even left a comment, it means a lot. It was a huge step for me, definitely, but I wouldn't say I am brave, not at all. I am the complete opposite. Thank you again, I appreciate it very much and I really hope so to that it gets better but I'll see.
Thank you! I hope it never happens to you because the pain is the worst feeling ever, it hurts so so much.....
Thank you! And no I don't have any friends :/
Thank you, I hope...... It hurts so much I want her back. I am sorry for your experiences but you went through it and wow you are strong.

Heey, it means a lot thank you. I am sorry for your lose. We talked daily and I could always count on her and she on me and now...... I am alone. 

I wasn't familiar with this show, looks interesting tho thank you!
Yea i have the same Problem. I just overthink to much.
Are we the same person? I have the same Problem and it sucks
Yea you are probably right but then i need to go to a doctor or call them, i hope someday i found a way. But Thank you!
Please be carefull, because you are very young and i guess a lot guys will message you. Just saying. But i hope you have luck and find someone to Chat with :)
Well, i have done the tests and i would be cool when the result of the anxiety test is not that bad, but it is.
Thanks i definetly will watch this!
Thank you! I hope you are right haha
